### Rahab Trusts the God of Israel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rahab-trusts-god-of-israel
Passage: Joshua 2:11
Points:
- Faith in the Lord is fully compatible with taking wise, prudent actions.
- While all of Jericho trembled in fear, only Rahab responded by seeking refuge in God.
- Genuine faith prompts a sinner to abandon false idols and cast themselves upon the Lord.
- Because God rules supreme over heaven and earth, our only safety from His wrath is found in Him.
- Believers must continually turn from sin and trust in Christ throughout daily life.

### Just Step Out in Faith
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-mar-19-2009-11601085.html
Passage: Joshua 2:11
Points:
- Rahab chose the Lord's side after hearing reports of His mighty deeds at the Red Sea.
- God works ahead of His people, preparing hearts and circumstances before they even arrive.
- The conquest of the land was rooted in God's promises and power, not human strength.
- Christians are called to step forward in faith even when the path ahead seems uncertain.
- Trusting God's presence dispels fear and opens the way through seemingly impassable obstacles.

### By Name and Not Profession: Rahab's Story
Author: Drew Williams
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/by-name-and-not-profession-rahab-s-story.html
Passage: Joshua 2:11
Points:
- Rahab made a courageous, life-risking choice to shelter the spies based on what she heard of God.
- Her confession was an uncompromising declaration that the Lord is the only true God in heaven and earth.
- Her testimony of faith infused the Israelite spies with courage and certainty in God's victory.
- God receives and redeems outsiders, knowing them by name rather than defining them by their past.
- The power of faith rests not on its quantity, but on the trustworthiness of the One being trusted.

### Bible Pathways 03/13/05
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-13-or-05-1315791.html
Passage: Joshua 2:9-11
Points:
- Hearing of God's wonders led Rahab to forsake her idols and trust the mercy of the one true God.
- God providentially guided the spies to her home to secure deliverance for her family.
- By choosing faith over her pagan surroundings, Rahab became an ancestor in the lineage of Christ.
- The scarlet cord hung in her window stands as an Old Testament picture of redemption through Christ's blood.
- Believers are challenged to reject worldly compromises and live to please God faithfully.
